nodes.rationale: Enqueue on notify; send asynchronously via cron/worker. Do not send synchronously inside HTTP requests if the gateway is slow/offline.

nodes.label: SMS Soft-Fail Delivery Principle

nodes.label: RealDirectorySeeder Graceful Skip

nodes.label: Single Monolith Laravel Architecture
nodes.rationale: No microservices at 100–500 employee scale; team bus factor mitigated by single Laravel codebase and clear module boundaries.

nodes.label: Config-Driven Compliance Engine
nodes.rationale: Salary grades, BIR brackets, GSIS/PhilHealth/PAG-IBIG rates are data rows not hardcoded — annual rate changes update a row without redeploy.

nodes.label: Effective-Dated Records Pattern
nodes.rationale: Appointments and salary changes carry effective_from/effective_to so retroactive adjustments never corrupt past payroll periods.

nodes.label: Append-Only Ledgers Pattern
nodes.rationale: Leave credits and payroll history are immutable; corrections are new entries for audit/COA readiness.

nodes.label: CTO-Eligible Rest-Day Holiday Punches
nodes.rationale: Punches never blocked on rest days/holidays because those timelogs are evidence for Compensatory Time-Off claims.

nodes.label: Payroll computation_json Audit Trace
nodes.rationale: Mitigates payroll calculation error risk — every payslip can be explained years later.
